limitations: No live camera or processed-negative source; service never simulates captures. Positive updates and inference are deferred.
Old-renderer/old-character detection model is provisional. Explicit inclusion cohort leaves uninferred conditions out; manifest is unchanged.
Full-person frames only; sparse capture phase, assumed lateral symmetry and edge taper, and 30 m nominal AGL transfer. Wilson envelope excludes renderer and cohort correlation uncertainty.
No verified non-dementia elderly distance table. Hiker source is Australian mixed data, not Yosemite-local. Doke source was inaccessible.
Original Stone/Frost and NSS/IAMSAR texts were not directly verified; authoritative secondary search-theory citations are retained.
Stationary radial prior omits subject motion and terrain/features; in-world conditioning discards substantial mass, explicitly reported.
Finite greedy track-spacing/direction comparison and fixed spatial sectors are not globally optimal allocation or guaranteed equal endurance.
POS curves are model expectations, not detections or measured success. Timing uses nominal 5 m/s, climb and turn assumptions; measured terrain-leg speed medians were about 3.1 m/s.
Endurance and reserve are simulation policy, not aircraft measurements. SITL percentage gauges reached zero while voltage stayed 12.6 V; this flight does not validate physical energy endurance.
SAM offered load does not establish complete multi-prompt SAM/Glimmer pipeline throughput.
Static planned separation is not collision avoidance; actual separation and clearance audits are sampled. Built-in physics does not collide with the Open Meadow heightfield.
Boundary quadrature is approximate; normalization is exact to the asserted tolerance. Refinement evidence is retained.
Final pan rate meets the stated 58 FPS threshold but is slightly below the earlier measured 58.855 FPS baseline.
